required_database_guards: AppendOnly models: reject UPDATE and ordinary DELETE; permit only separately reviewed explicit retention/purge/import capability.
JudgeScore: reject changing an already submitted judgment; immutable evidence remains after assignment invalidation.
JudgingRound: configuration/mode/rubric freeze after open; criteria writes lock parent then require draft.
All event/round/role/sponsor/track/snapshot/asset/team/website/result/publication FK paths agree on event and tenant.
JudgeRankingChoice: assignment shares ballot round/judge/batch; distinct snapshot and rank; round is open at insert.
Gallery selections: typed asset/link belongs to exact pinned snapshot and team; selection metadata/title/description frozen; hide/version/reason allowed.
ResultPublicationState current announcement belongs to same event; GalleryPublication result and GalleryAmendment result are same event.
Resume consent: sponsor/asset/member/event/hash/purpose agree; granted state never inherited by replacement asset.
Score criterion JSON uses frozen criterion keys and integer 1..5 when submitted; no direct alternate status writers.

JudgePairwiseComparison: previous/current assignments share its round and judge; round is open at insert unless importing; append-only. JudgePairwiseInvalidation: append-only, same event as its comparison. JudgePairwiseCursor: previous/current assignments share its round and judge.
registry_integration: G installs all model/field/export/import/user/unique/source/authority/encryption/purge mappings before importing URLs.
Import rewrites only declared typed IDs, retains source_content_sha256 provenance and recomputes result content_sha256; asset hashes never change.
All D private content is event owned. No storage keys, presigns, User credentials, account vault data or global organizations are copied into a D model.
D operation receipts use G EventCommandReceipt exactly; uniqueness event/actor/operation_uuid; response_reference JSON safe IDs/versions only; DROP portable coordination.
Retention anchors are A/B owned. D sets the first-result timestamp once through the asserted locked port, never after corrections.
generation: Literal AST field definitions, generated and checked against D source; all implicit PKs and abstract-base fields expanded.
purge_dependency_order: B/C/A-owned snapshots/assets/roles/teams only after references are gone
required_runtime_ports: apps.events.judging.ports.ProgrammePorts: install after provider/authority/source/fence readiness; no legacy User-locking authority helper; A locks team parent before D consent children.
